stories.title: Berlin opens a mobility consultation
stories.summary: Berlin published a consultation on a local mobility plan. It matters because the proposal could change everyday transport priorities in the city.

stories.title: German data release reframes the growth outlook
stories.summary: Germany released new economic figures that prompted a reassessment of near-term growth. It matters for household confidence, fiscal policy, and domestic business conditions.

stories.title: Germany updates an election timetable
stories.summary: The Federal Returning Officer published an updated election timetable. It matters because official dates and procedures should take precedence over campaign reporting.

stories.title: A humanitarian situation receives a material update
stories.summary: International reporting described a significant update to an ongoing humanitarian situation. It matters because the change may affect civilian safety and the international response.

stories.title: A euro-area policy signal moves into focus
stories.summary: European institutions published a policy update affecting the regional outlook. It matters for inflation expectations, investment conditions, and German businesses.

stories.title: A European business deal changes a competitive landscape
stories.summary: Reporting described a business transaction with implications for a European market. It matters because the deal could affect competition, investment, and employment.

stories.title: A market-structure development merits attention
stories.summary: A financial development may change how investors assess a sector. It is a watch item rather than a trading signal and needs continued evidence.
